player_prompt.intro:
Yɛrɛ Player {player_id} ka tɛmɛ Checkers kɛlɛ {color}.
Kɛlɛmɛ tɔɔrɔ kɛlɛ chess-style notation [fileRank fileRank], pɔɔrɛ '[b2c3]' (column kɔlɔmɛ a–h, row kɔlɔmɛ 0–7).
Kɛlɛmɛ laada:
  • Tɔɔrɔ kɔnɔnɔnɔ kɛlɛ 1 yɛrɛ empty.
  • Fɔɔrɔ kɛlɛmɛ kɛlɛ kɔnɔnɔnɔ yɛrɛ opponent piece.
  • Piece kɛlɛ Kinged yɛrɛ kɛlɛ opposite end.
